name: Onetimesecret
description: Share sensitive information securely with self-destructing links that are only viewable once.
composeYaml:
services:
  onetimesecret:
    image: 'onetimesecret/onetimesecret:latest'
    environment:
      - 'AUTH_AUTOVERIFY=${AUTH_AUTOVERIFY:-true}'
      - 'AUTH_SIGNUP=${AUTH_SIGNUP:-true}'
      - 'COLONEL=${COLONEL:-admin@example.com}'
      - 'HOST=${HOST:-localhost}'
      - 'REDIS_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@redis:6379/0'
      - 'SECRET=${ONETIMESECRET}'
      - 'SSL=${SSL:-false}'
      - RACK_ENV=production
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - ruby
        - '-rnet/http'
        - '-e'
        - "exit(Net::HTTP.get_response(URI('http://localhost:3000')).is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess) ? 0 : 1)"
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
  redis:
    image: 'redis:8-alpine'
    command: 'redis-server --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - redis-cli
        - ping
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
